packages.label: מִשְׁפְּטֵי הַתּוֹרָה וּפוֹסְקִים
packages.reason: The Torah makes explicit that 'mishpetei haTorah' (the laws and judgments of Torah) ARE the Poskim — they are two names for the same essential thing. The Poskim are not a means to Torah law; they ARE the clarification and embodiment of Torah law. Both refer to the domain of halachic adjudication, which clarifies divine law. This bechina is confirmed by the proof text: 'מִשְׁפְּטֵי הַתּוֹרָה, בְּחִינַת פּוֹסְקִים'. This is the active force in the Torah's argument: studying the Poskim establishes dominion over the earth (ארץ), which in turn uncovers the sunken gates of Gan Eden. The domain is entirely good/holy — Torah study and legal clarification.
